Izzy K.: Need a compact battlecard refresh for the upcoming launch: two quick competitor vectors (Cloud-A managed endpoints, LLM-API-B) + 3 rebut scripts for SDRs. Keep it <= 1 page.

Tom H.: Proposed vectors:
1) Lock-in & ops cost: Cloud-A hides routing and autoscale but costs explode with long-context.
2) Performance unpredictability: LLM-API-B can spike tail latency under bursty workloads.

Priya N.: Rebut scripts (short):
- To Platform Eng: 'We give predictable p99 SLAs and transparent batching knobs — ask for our 2-min bench CDF.'
- To Product: 'Ship faster: same API surface across hosted/dedicated/private so you don't rewire integration.'
- To Security: 'Private control plane + KMS integrations for audit-heavy workloads.'

Sara L.: Add objections and counters:
- "We already use Cloud-A": emphasize unit-econ & rollback policies for canaries.
- "We prefer fully-managed": stress predictable cost and private deploy option.

Izzy K.: Deliverable plan: I'll draft the 1-pager and share with sales by Tue AM. Tom  can you provide a sanitized bench blurb (non-numeric) to slot in?

Tom H.: Yep will drop a sentence and a small CDF screenshot (sanitized) by Mon EOD.

ops-bot: Reminder: use the legal checklist before publishing claims.

Izzy K.: Thanks everyone — targeting roll-out to SDRs on Wed morning.
